name: react-render-audit
description: Find where a real React or Next.js app is slow and fix the re-renders that cause it, without changing behavior: /optimize-renders times a user flow in headless Chrome on mobile and desktop profiles first, records every component render with its cause and cost where steps are slow, fixes the causes that cost the most time with the react-best-practices skills, keeps a fix only if behavior stayed identical and a timing benchmark shows the slow step got faster, and writes a before/after report. When nothing is slow, it says so and changes nothing.
